verdict.rationale: Exporting one's personal account data is a fair question for an online government services portal, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents a way to export all user data in open formats. Accessing individual tax notices (CFE/IFER avis) and the public 'Statistiques et Données' section are adjacent features, not a personal data export capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
